items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: my neighbor... he and Scotty... was the cop's name... they were long time friends, so they both come to my door and knocked on my door and there was Scotty with his head down and we just fell out.

ctx.x: Yeah...the policeman there was called the King Cole Trio...in a patrol car... that was their beat. So they used to come in there and, shoot, they put on another coat and sit down and enjoy themselves and bring their companion and party like everybody else. So everybody knew 'em, you know, and everything was cool. But one night one of 'em got real happy. He had on a civilian coat and he got on the floor and...he was from Charlestown, South Carolina...and he did that gee-chee dance. He was in time but his gun fell…

all night long. My God! Teddy Hill used to come in and dance all night long. But I tried to keep the atmosphere real. The main thing was that we played good music and I was always tryin' to keep the place lively, you know what I mean. Keep people happy. And that job was where I really actually found out about what I'm all about. Nick, you know, what makes me...what motivates me as a musician and as a person and as a person on stage. Now I basically...I love my fellow human being and I guess that was always in me,…
